header: Branch adaptive-instruments. Geodesic columns at 31935b89 (C22 3D turns with held links, C23 head-on and merged meeting line); the AgentSearch control on Corne is the D-FIX1 run at cdc9814e (AgentSearch output is byte-identical across the two commits: byte parity). Rough ops only. No ranking. Column geodesic_local_zigzag_v2 (C25b: the C23 head-on rule in 3D) is at 4cceca914, run once with --sim-artifact; the binary in the line below is that build. Binary note: the page runs used the release CLI built at 13:40:24; the sim-artifact reruns (for the load share) used a rebuild at 13:50:30 from the same 31935b89 source (a probe revert touched a file mtime); every rerun's program.nc is byte-equal to its page run.
method: Source of the link tags: the semantic_trace of each run's tp_*.json (entry spans 'plunge entry' and 'keep-down link', depth levels 'Global Z'), matched to the exported G-code by move index (move i = command line i+1 of the op's section). Turns carry no tag in the trace, so they are drawn blue with the cuts. Corne: images show '3D Rough 1' only; the table gives both rough ops. Corne exports used --accept-unmodeled-tool-load (the skipped 'Waterline 3' has a stale sim). wanaka200 runs use wanaka200_mt1_c12_rough_only.toml: the c12 copy with 7 non-rough ops removed (1 Pin Drill, 3 Holes, 4 Rivers, 5 Lakes, 7 tier-A R2.0, 7b tier-B rest R1.0, 8 Pencil R0.5) so the 0.1 mm rest rule does not apply; the earlier c12 copy also carries the Drill depth to floor migration (R-B/F19). wanaka200 sim cell 1.0 mm (coarsened for time).
turn_note: Planned zigzag turns that are not cut (heavy C12 test: 95 planned, 56 cut): in the one-level C12 test (46 planned, 27 cut) a temporary probe found that each of the 19 is a plunge. The cleaned plan lifts the cutter at the end of the arc and re-enters at the turn's start, so the turn runs as the first step out of that plunge (most of them at the island side); the heavy test's 39 were not probed one by one.
